purpose: Tracks primary-source land-pattern evidence before a footprint is used for physical freeze or geometry-sensitive routing.

reviewed: 16 SMT contacts: 12 x 0.30 mm and 4 x 0.60 mm, all 1.15 mm long
4 plated shell slots with the drawing's 0.60 mm slot width and 1.00 mm copper width
Contact and shell-slot relative locations match the recommended PCB layout

J1.limitation: This verifies the connector land pattern only. The interleaved USB D+/D- breakout still requires a separately reviewed routing recipe.
